rows.question: How do I set up MFA on a new phone?
rows.expected: Raise a "Reset MFA" ticket first; once resolved install Northwind Authenticator and scan the QR code (mfa_setup_guide.md)
rows.answer:
To set up MFA on a new phone, follow these steps [1]:

1. Raise a ticket titled "Reset MFA" so the service desk can clear your old MFA registration [1]
2. Once the ticket is resolved, install Northwind Authenticator from the App Store or Google Play [1]
3. Sign in to any work app. When asked, scan the QR code shown on screen with the app [1]
4. Enter the six-digit code to finish [1]

rows.question: How long do you keep daily server backups?
rows.answer: Daily server backups are kept for 30 days [1].

rows.question: My VPN keeps cutting out at home. What can I try?
rows.expected: Update NorthLink to 5.2+; use a cable or move closer to the router; switch protocol from Auto to TCP (vpn_troubleshooting.md)
rows.answer:
Here are steps to fix VPN disconnections at home:

1. **Check your NorthLink version** – Make sure you're running version 5.2 or later, as older versions drop connections on weak Wi-Fi [2].

2. **Improve your Wi-Fi signal** – Move closer to your router or connect with a network cable instead [2].

3. **Change the protocol** – Switch the protocol in NorthLink settings from "Auto" to "TCP". This fixes most random disconnects [2].

4. **Note the 12-hour limit** – The VPN disconnects automatically after 12 hours, so you'll need to reconnect and sign in again [3].

If these steps don't work, open a ticket on the service desk portal and attach the NorthLink log file (Help > Export logs) [1].

rows.question: What laptop does a new starter get?
rows.answer:
According to the new starter checklist, a new starter can choose between two laptop types: **Standard or Developer** [1].

The specific laptop model assigned depends on which type is chosen by the manager when submitting the "New starter" request in the service desk portal [1].

rows.question: I forgot my password and cannot sign in. What do I do?
rows.expected: Use the self-service page reset.northwind.example and approve MFA; if MFA fails contact the service desk (password_policy.md)
rows.answer:
To reset your forgotten password, follow these steps [1]:

1. Go to the self-service page at reset.northwind.example
2. Enter your work email and approve the MFA prompt
3. Choose a new password that meets the policy requirements (at least 14 characters, not reusing your last 10 passwords) [1]

If you cannot pass the MFA step, contact the service desk. They will verify your identity with your manager before resetting your password [2].

rows.question: How big a file can I email to a colleague?
rows.expected: 25 MB attachment limit; use a NorthDrive link for larger files (email_and_calendar_faq.md)
rows.answer: You can email attachments up to 25 MB [1]. For larger files, you should share a NorthDrive link instead [1].
